rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded Day-5 blastocyst with thinning zona, compact ICM, and somewhat looser TE consistent with 3AB; minor uncertainty/fabrication from a single static image but overall accurate.
Strong integration of age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, tubal factor/hydrosalpinx concern, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo prognosis.

Reasoning is generally logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and clinical context; slight looseness from giving multiple overlapping ranges and some speculative protocol comments.

Largely consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice: SET, hydrosalpinx evaluation, luteal support, optional PGT-A at age 32. Minor deviations include speculative mention of AI/protocol changes without strong case-specific indication.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including hydrosalpinx exclusion, luteal support, cavity assessment, early pregnancy monitoring, and protocol review if low yield recurs; useful though not highly detailed operationally.
